hook.name: AccessControlDynamicFeeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts liquidity provision to an owner-managed allowlist, applies asymmetric directional dynamic LP fees (separate rates for zeroForOne vs oneForZero), enforces configurable sqrtPrice bounds (reverting swaps that push the pool outside [min, max]), and optionally charges an additional hook fee taken from swappers via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism.
